summary: Comprehensive revision of the implementation plan incorporating: 1) Full CRUD management for Safety Performance Indicators (SPI) and Safety Performance Targets (SPT) with alert levels, 2) Controlled Safety Bulletins & Documents section with mandatory staff acknowledgment tracking, and 3) Direct Safety Bulletin / Internal Operational Notice (ION) issuance trigger at the final closure step of any Safety Report or Audit Finding with auto reference numbering.
